spans.s:
शोण्(ऋ)शोणृ r. 1st cl. (शोणति)
 1. To be red.
 2. To move or approach.

शोण mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं)
 1. Crimson, of a crimson colour.
 2. Red in
the face, from passion, &c.
 m. (-णः)
 1. Crimson, the colour of the
red lotus.
 2. A horse of a reddish or bright chesnut colour.
 3. The
Śona river, which rises in the table land of Amerakantāk and
running first northerly and then easterly for 500 miles, falls into
the Ganges above

. A flower, (Bignonia Indica.)
 5. Fire
or its deity.
 6. An ocean.
 7. A red sort of sugar-cane.
 8. The
planet Mars.
 n. (-णं)
 1. Red-lead.
 2. Blood.
 E. शोण् to be red, aff.
अच्, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीप् ।

शोणक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
 E. कन् added to the preceding.

शोणाक m. (-कः) A tree, (Bignonia Indica.)
 E. शोण red, अक् to go or be, aff. अच्.

शोणरत्न n. (-त्नं) A ruby.
 E. शोण deep red, and रत्न a gem.

शोणाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) Name of a cloud which would rise at the destruction
of the world.

शोणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Red, crimson, purple.
 n. (-तं)
 1.

. Saff-
ron.
 E. शोण redness, इतच् aff.

शोणितप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what drinks blood.
 E. शोणित and पा to drink, क aff.

शोणितपुर n. (-रं) The city of Vānāsura.
 E. शोणित red, and पुर city.

शोणितोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stained or sprinkled with blood.
 E. शोणित, and उक्षित moistened.

शोणितोपल n. (-लं) A ruby.
 E. शोणित red, and उपल a stone.

शोणिमन् m. (-मा) Redness.
 E. शोण् and इमनिच् aff.
